exposure: gestational age at the time of ECV attempt
outcome: emergent cesarean delivery rate due to ECV
cohort: The study included 258 patients who underwent external cephalic version (ECV) at a Canadian tertiary care centre between January 2018 and December 2022.
finding: The overall ECV success rate was 31%, with multiparity, transverse presentation, and neonatal birthweight >3.3 kg significantly increasing success, while uterine relaxant use was associated with a lower success rate.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was an outcome, and the emergency cesarean delivery rate due to ECV was 10%.
birth_weight: >3.3 kg (as a variable associated with success)
gest_age: At the time of ECV attempt (implied term breech for ECV candidacy)
